title: Orbs of the Omniscient
description: Collect the orbs and restore the world to its former glory, fantasy adventure RPG style
body:
Orbs of the Omniscient is a fantasy adventure modpacked intended to recreate the feel of an RPG but in a sandbox, open world setting. Your task is simple: Explore the world, conquer the corruption, and retrieve the missing orbs needed to unlock access to the final boss: a revamped ender dragon.

Features include:
- New biomes and environments to explore from [Wilder Wild](https://modrinth.com/mod/wilder-wild), [Pyrellium](https://modrinth.com/mod/pyrellium) and [Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape)
- New structures to conquer from [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns), [Legacies and Legends](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacies-and-legends), and [Trailier Tales](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailier-tales)
- New mobs to fight from [Variants and Ventures](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-and-ventures), [Friends and Foes](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes), and [Illager Invasion](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-invasion)
- New magical mechanics with [Fated Inventory](https://modrinth.com/mod/fated-inventory), [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones), and [Magical Scepter](https://modrinth.com/mod/magical-scepter)
- Overhauls of vanilla systems with [Combat Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/combat-reborn), [Enchants and Expeditions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchants-and-expeditions) and [Shifting Wares](https://modrinth.com/mod/shifting-wares)
- Various small mods to bring the world to life, including [Nether Archives](https://modrinth.com/mod/nether-archives), [Slime Minibiome](https://modrinth.com/mod/slime-minibiome), and [The Copperier Age](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-copperier-age)
- Quality of life mods such as [Clutter No More](https://modrinth.com/mod/clutter-no-more), [Gravestones](https://modrinth.com/mod/pneumono_gravestones), and [Comforts](https://modrinth.com/mod/comforts)
- Optimizations from [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)/[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), and [ImmedietelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
